subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a canonical per-model total request deadline for agents.defaults.models entries, beyond the existing global agent and provider-scoped timeout controls?
rationale: Current controls cover whole turns and provider requests, but the requested same-provider, different-model policy needs a new compatibility-sensitive configuration contract and a precise definition of what is aborted.

options.title: Add one per-model deadline
options.body: Define one per-model total request budget with explicit precedence beneath the agent/run ceiling and clear fallback timeout classification.

options.title: Keep provider and global controls only
options.body: Document models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds plus agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds as the supported boundary and decline additional model-entry configuration.

options.title: Split the semantics first
options.body: Track total-generation, no-first-token, and repetition-loop safeguards as separate designs before adding any new configuration field.

recommendation.title: Add one per-model deadline
recommendation.body: Define one per-model total request budget with explicit precedence beneath the agent/run ceiling and clear fallback timeout classification.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and recent embedded-runner work place steipete closest to the timeout semantics and compatibility tradeoff.
